image_description: A medium shot of a guenon monkey (likely a Green Monkey or similar species) sitting on a mossy tree branch. The monkey has olive-green and brown fur with a distinctive white chest and belly, and a prominent facial ruff. Its face is bare-skinned with dark eyes and a narrow nose. One arm is extended along the branch, showing long fingers. The background consists of blurred green foliage, indicating an arboreal setting.
